The fun song ‘Dingle Dangle Scarecrow’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Together Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy
programme.desc: Elsee plays I-spy in the hair salon with her new friend Royalty.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Worm farmer Heather and the Fact Pack get hands-on with wiggly worms! We learn how wonderful worms help plants grow.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk to an old castle. On the way, they explore the rocky beach, go through a magic archway, walk like crabs and even see a pirate!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou invents a new kind of race in which the slowest is the winner.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo don’t want to tidy the playroom, so they get Daddy Robot to do it for them. But when Bluey takes things too far, Daddy Robot malfunctions – with disastrous results.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are off for a jamboree to make some new friends, play games and have a picnic. They meet another group of young animals with their very own version of Duggee, but everything they do is different - even Roly finds one of them too LOUD!

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: An excitable Red arrives in Colourland. Learn about the colour red with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Xiangfeng wants to know all about amazing ants! Ferne visits a leaf cutter ant colony at the zoo, while Rory and his son Sandy head into the forest, looking for wood ants. Also, we find out how ants play an important role in the growing of plants and crops. They are amazing soil engineers!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Mum and Dad have a treat in store for George and Freddie. It’s a special tennis game including dinosaurs, bees, and smiley faces. But will they score an ace? Later, George and Freddie get the face paints out and transform Mum and Dad into colourful cats. What will they think of their amazing makeovers?

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Small is entering the local talent show, but she’s forgotten the words to her song. Meanwhile, Mike the music man comes to visit, Small flies off to see how celery grows, and the two chefs serve a delicious risotto drum to their talented guest.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: When guide dog Kika has a waggy tail-related accident with a purple smoothie, she and her owner Dr Amit visit the Woofton Library of Things to borrow a carpet cleaner.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s the start of a new day, and Wren has made a card for her best friend Emmy. Outside, Wren, Emmy and Ayat discover a ladybird, which soon flies away. They go in search of their new fluttery friend, but will they be able to find it? Later, it’s Solomon’s turn to sit at the VIP table as he has been doing so well at school, and he chooses Lusungu as his guest. Finally, Sophie has a fun activity for Wren, Solomon and Lusungu - they are going on a pretend train trip in search of dinosaurs.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle won’t move from his new doggy doormat because he loves it very much. Jess opens the door to reveal Gram and Grand have come to visit and Grand has made coconut cake for everyone plus a special cake for Waffle but Waffle won’t move from his doggy door mat to greet him. Gram and Grand discover that Waffle can talk and Evie tells them Waffle’s learning to read, too. Gram gives Waffle a congratulatory snuggle and Waffle loves it!

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Mama and Papa are taking Oona and Baba on a family outing to experience something special - Papa tells them it's a big surprise. Oona and Baba are very excited to see it, but they need to find the perfect spot - which isn't easy. In the end, the amazing surprise makes all of their effort worth it.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: When Rock Night is double-booked, everyone's beloved Sundial Stage quickly becomes a crowded and noisy place to be. It’s up to Yukee to help her friends rediscover that things sound better when everyone plays together.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are having a sleepover at Nana and Dadó's, and they have a whole list of things they want to do. But when the electricity suddenly goes out, the group are forced to think of other ways to entertain themselves. Do they really need electricity to have fun with their family?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Fred and Dana ask the Piggies to plan fun outdoor games for Keith and Rebecca. Each piggy comes up with an idea, but Cesar’s is so ambitious that he can’t tackle it alone!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Rocket Ten and friends blast off into space for a rhyming adventure to visit planets 11 to 20. Explore numbers 11 to 20 with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The Alphablocks meet their match when Brown Cow and her singing friends Owl, Howl and Growl take the stage! This episode has fun with the '-ow-' digraph and the words cow, brown, owl, howl, growl, gown, crown, town and down.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Today, Justin and his friend go to the library and finish their day with a treat in the library cafe. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble uses his imagination by playing 'library' with the toys.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play choo-choo and follow the Tubby Custard Machine on a Tubby Custard Ride. In Tummy Tales, children follow their nursery teacher to the local playground.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Bean the warthog looks for a new den with the help of his friends, Hamza discovers some very loud Egyptian geese and helps make milk bottles for the hungry animals.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s stall. She chooses the wobbly coffee pot mug and remembers the day she got it. Moira reads a bad online review of the Big Hub and worries that if word gets out, it will have to close. The review describes Kez’s stall as messy, so Moira decides to hold a stall inspection to sort things out. Although Molly loves the creative chaos of Kez’s stall, she agrees to help Kez tidy up before the inspection. Moira arrives for her inspection of Kez’s stall, and despite the stall being spotless, one Hub rule is broken, so Kez’s stall must close for the day. Meanwhile, Molly has an idea which could help Kez. As Moira inspects all the other stalls, she finds the same rule has been broken by everyone, including herself. Molly helps Moira realise that, unless she wants to close down all the stalls, she will have to rethink some of her rules.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies' very own motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that all move because of propellers! Grace flies a seaplane, shows off an unusual hydrocopter and goes for a fast ride in a raceboat!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger helps a short Broccoliosaurus reach high flowers with a clever solution.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When the Reef Base’s power is knocked out, Octo-Agents lead the charge to restore it.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When a big storm wrecks the rabbits' treehouse, piecing it back together leads to a big adventure.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It is Tag's birthday and Duggee has put up a bouncy castle to celebrate. It's a lovely sunny day, and the squirrels are all excited. They are just about to get bouncing when a big, gloomy cloud settles down and falls asleep right over the bouncy castle. How can they wake it up? Well, they could bounce up and tell it to move. Is this something Hedgley the hedgehog can help them with?

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s Silas and his classmates' first full day at school! There are lots of things to explore, new friends to make and teachers to meet. After meeting the teachers, the children explore the classroom and outdoor area. At lunchtime, Ottilie and Bryn ‘spot’ an invisible mouse in the dining hall. Lusungu finds that opening yogurt lids can be a bit tricky. Luckily, Mrs Farrell is on hand to help. The day continues as Silas and Maily create family portraits. Silas has fun drawing his mum's, but finds it harder to draw his pet cats - so he draws rabbits instead!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and Tomato are making friendship bracelets in the craft aisle, but this gives Evil Pea the crafty idea of making a monster costume to scare them all out of the supermarket. With herself and the Corn Cobs stacked on top of each other, they initially get the veggies to run away. Supertato wonders if the monster is just looking for a new friend, so he chases after it! When one of the arms falls off the monster, the Tato Team realise it’s just someone in a costume. They find out it was Evil Pea all along!

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: It’s Weasy’s birthday! He is keen to find out if the ducklings got him his dream present, but he keeps ruining their party preparations. The ducklings immobilise Weasy, which gives the Chipmunk an opportunity to steal his presents.

programme.title: Do Not Watch This Show
programme.desc: It's a smelly disaster - the longer you stay tuned, the worse everything stinks!

programme.title: Bluey

programme.desc: Zog is too scared to fly after a bad crash landing, so Boom helps the doctors as their ambulance. Zog must overcome his fear and get back to the team.

Suddenly, Jake and Dash turn into babies, leaving Rafi in charge! It’s funny at first, but soon the mess grows. Rafi realises being a grown-up means taking responsibility. She cleverly mixes tidying with dancing, showing them chores can be fun too. When the wish ends, her dads return to normal and are proud of Rafi’s maturity and teamwork.

programme.desc: JoJo is having a summer sleepover at Gran Gran's house and has brought everything she needs from home, including her favourite bedtime storybook. But JoJo is confused when Gran Gran suggests it might be bed-time, even though the sun is still shining in the sky! JoJo wanted to see the twinkly sleepover stars before she slept, just like the ones on the cover of her storybook. Gran Gran resolves to use fairy lights to create their own night time starry sky, and JoJo learns that the sun stays in the sky longer during summer.

programme.title: Inside Iran: War & Revolution
programme.desc: Following unprecedented protests and a devastating military conflict, Iranian citizens are risking their lives to share what truly happened inside their country. programme.title: Inside Iran: War & Revolution
programme.desc: Following unprecedented protests and a devastating military conflict, Iranian citizens are risking their lives to share what truly happened inside their country. The film features exclusive, on-the-ground footage and interviews with ordinary people, journalists, and grieving families - many speaking anonymously - who survived the brutal 2026 uprising and subsequent war. Through their detailed first-hand accounts, this documentary - for the BAFTA-winning ITV Exposure strand - explores how the Islamic Republic's ruthless crackdown on civilian demonstrations escalated into a terrifying international crisis. Their testimonies expose harrowing scenes of internet blackouts, state-sanctioned killings of unarmed protesters, and the devastating reality of life under US and Israeli bombardment. The film pieces together a rare, unfiltered picture from inside Iran - capturing a resilient population caught in the deadly crossfire of domestic authoritarianism and global warfare.

programme.title: Long Lost Family: What Happened Next
programme.desc: A look at what happened next to foundling Susanne Barrow, left in an East London phone box. In 2024, Susanne met a blood relative for the first time - her half-brother Brian, who shares the same birth father. Since then, they've become inseparable and added another paternal half-sibling to their close circle. But a vital part of Susanne's search was unresolved. She'd ended her programme with a gentle plea: "If my birth mother's still alive, I just want her to maybe get in contact." Two years on, has anyone come forward? And for foundling Tom Yeo, left under a bench in the waiting room of Reading train station in 1965, there's been an unusual development: his extraordinary story has had more impact than he could have imagined.

programme.desc: Sitcom about three desperate young men who reside in ancient Rome. Marcus's parents are visiting for the weekend and he is keen to keep them and Delphine as far apart as possible - as Stylax pursues a romance with Ursula, one of the Vestal Virgins who guard the city's sacred flame, Grumio finds some mouldy cheese under his bed and spots a business opportunity.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Comedy series providing an honest, uplifting and heart-warming portrayal of the lives of working-class teenagers from Liverpool while tackling issues with a refreshing humour. It's Careers Week at the school and Christopher's taking it very seriously, but Reece and the boys see it as an opportunity to slack off. When a local barrister conducts a mock trial in class, Reece and Christopher end up as rival solicitors in a case about who has hacked Aimee's TikTok and posted videos ridiculing other girls at the school in a bid to sabotage her reputation. The chief suspect is her ex Lewis, but Reece discovers fresh evidence that leads to a dramatic conclusion to the trial - elsewhere, casting director Jenson, who claims to be a man of the people, holds auditions for a new film depicting working-class kids. Aimee's thrilled, but not only is she having trouble at home as her dad Wayne is unwell, but slick, polished and middle-class Grace seems to be impressing Jenson.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Home improvement programme where contractor Brian McCourt and designer Sarah Keenleyside help to expand living spaces by tapping into people's backyards. When Paris lovers Louise and Rick want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage, Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape that is 'magnifique'.

programme.title: Dress To Impress
programme.desc: Three fashion-savvy competitors take part in a shopping showdown in Manchester hoping to win a blind date with a style-conscious singleton. Telecoms worker Sophie from Middlesbrough is hoping to find a dream guy, but which of three singletons - Aidas, Connor or Harees - will impress the most with their fashion choices and win a date?

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Potomac
programme.desc: Reality series following six women living in Potomac, Maryland, a suburb of Washington D.C. and one of the most affluent towns in the United States. Karen invites all of the couples to a fun day of pickleball, but things soon get heated both on and off the court - meanwhile, Candiace comes face to face with Robyn and Gizelle, everyone is surprised when a certain husband makes an appearance, and Nneka confronts Wendy with some shocking allegations.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Follow the lavish lives of six savvy champagne-swilling Beverly Hills women who were born for shopping and partying! Las Vegas starts with a bang as the women hold an intervention for Sutton as she is disappointed with her dating life - however, when Erika treats the group to a VIP experience at a sexy show for Crystal's 40th birthday, Sutton's reaction surprises the ladies. Meanwhile, Kyle's new workout routine raises questions as Garcelle opens up old wounds with Dorit.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: Amber is still questioning her future with Dan - she is frustrated about the lack of effort Dan is putting into their relationship. Diags tries to reassure her as he knows that Dan and Amber belong together, but will Amber be swayed by what Diags is saying, or is it all too little too late? There's an engagement in Essex, but despite Harry's best attempts, it's not Billy and Amy's - instead, it's Saff's dad's. Will this encourage Billy to pop the question, or will he buckle under the pressure? After his big announcement at his birthday party, Gatsby is getting ready to join his family in LA, but not before one last Essex party with his nearest and dearest. As the self-crowned King of Essex says his goodbyes, will it be tears all round, or is everyone happy that Gatsby will make his luck in LA? It wouldn't be TOWIE if there wasn't at least one clash of personalities... and have Chloe B and Junaid met their match when they come face to face for a war of words!

programme.title: Dawson's Creek
programme.desc: US drama series charting the ups and downs of adolescence as experienced by a group of precocious teenagers. As Capeside prepares to celebrate Hallowe'en, Dawson turns his attention to playing practical jokes on Pacey and Joey - unfortunately, the fun of the occasion is spoiled by disturbing reports of a serial killer on the loose that terrify the locals.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: Phoebe’s old flame comes to town after he and his partners steal a valuable urn that is guarded by a demon, putting Prue in jeopardy.

programme.title: Supermarket Sweep
programme.desc: Rylan Clark-Neal hosts the iconic game show as three pairs of shoppers go wild in the aisles and compete in the ultimate supermarket challenge to win a 3,000-pound prize - along with the classic Supermarket Sweep quizzes, trolley dashes and pastel jumpers, the revamped show features exciting new games, challenges and some famous faces.

programme.title: The Floor
programme.desc: The competition is heating up on The Floor - with just 57 players left, Rob Brydon hosts another tense round of quick-fire quiz duels. Each win expands a player's territory while each loss sends another home - with a 5,000-pound Floor Bonus on the line and a 50,000-pound jackpot up for grabs at the end of the series, it's all to play for as friends turn to foes and challenge each other.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: Part soap opera and part reality show, this programme follows the lives, loves and scandals of a group of real-life Essex guys and girls - cameras capture the happenings at all kinds of glamorous locations as the cast meet up in nail bars, nightclubs and salons.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Potomac

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Follow the lavish lives of six savvy champagne-swilling Beverly Hills women who were born for shopping and partying! The women recover after a meltdown in Las Vegas, but Erika's lift callout of Sutton leaves everyone floored - meanwhile, Dorit and Garcelle want Kyle to put her cards on the table about her marriage, the women celebrate Crystal's birthday with a bull-riding bonanza at a country bar, and Kyle's friendly check-up on Sutton back in Beverly Hills ends with major accusations.

programme.title: Celebrity Catchphrase

programme.title: Inside Iran: War & Revolution
programme.desc: Following unprecedented protests and a devastating military conflict, Iranian citizens are risking their lives to share what truly happened inside their country. The film features exclusive, on-the-ground footage and interviews with ordinary people, journalists, and grieving families - many speaking anonymously - who survived the brutal 2026 uprising and subsequent war. Through their detailed first-hand accounts, this documentary - for the BAFTA-winning ITV Exposure strand - explores how the Islamic Republic's ruthless crackdown on civilian demonstrations escalated into a terrifying international crisis. Their testimonies expose harrowing scenes of internet blackouts, state-sanctioned killings of unarmed protesters, and the devastating reality of life under US and Israeli bombardment. The film pieces together a rare, unfiltered picture from inside Iran - capturing a resilient population caught in the deadly crossfire of domestic authoritarianism and global warfare.

programme.title: Long Lost Family: What Happened Next
programme.desc: A look at what happened next to foundling Susanne Barrow, left in an East London phone box. In 2024, Susanne met a blood relative for the first time - her half-brother Brian, who shares the same birth father. Since then, they've become inseparable and added another paternal half-sibling to their close circle. But a vital part of Susanne's search was unresolved. She'd ended her programme with a gentle plea: "If my birth mother's still alive, I just want her to maybe get in contact." Two years on, has anyone come forward? And for foundling Tom Yeo, left under a bench in the waiting room of Reading train station in 1965, there's been an unusual development: his extraordinary story has had more impact than he could have imagined.
